The girl at the counter asked me if I wanted to sign up for there loyalty program so I could get a discount. I told her yes and she continued to scan my items. Towards the end she put 2 dog bones that she told me were made of vegetable and “complimentary” so I could try them out with my puppy. I thanked her and left the store. When I made it in my car I grabbed the receipt to double check everything just to notice that she had in fact charged me for the so called “complimentary treats”. Ruined the experience for me and I will not be back.

I recently purchased a large bag of dog food from this location, and it was filled with worms and bugs. The insects spread all over my entryway, and since I have young children, I immediately threw the contaminated food in the trash for safety reasons.

When I went back to the store to explain what happened and show videos, I was told that they would not issue a refund unless I brought the spoiled food back, even after I explained that the bugs and worms were all over my home. I had to go back home, dig the bag out of the trash, and bring it back just to get my refund $104 which was completely unnecessary given the circumstances.

I expected much better customer service and product quality from a store that specializes in pet care. I hope management reviews their handling of situations like this and their product storage conditions, because this was unacceptable.

This is by far the worst experience I’ve had at any pet store. Not a single staff member wanted to help with the fish section. I waited over 45 minutes, and not one person offered assistance. There were three girls standing at the front near the register just watching a cat being bathed, doing absolutely nothing to help customers.

One of them told me, “I’ll be right there,” and then completely disappeared for another 20 minutes. In the end, I walked out without being helped at all.

Corporate, this is unacceptable. Your staff is lazy, unprofessional, and clearly not trained in customer service. I will not be returning, and I will tell everyone I know to stay away from this location. DO NOT SHOP HERE. Save yourself the frustration.
